en: Of all things, my sword arm...

jp: クレイス様・・・・・・
インセストは二度と家族の元に
戻れないって本当なんですか？
en: Kreis-sama...... Is it true that Incests never get to go back to their families?
Yes. It is true.

jp: あたしをだましていたんですか？
en: ...Then you've been lying to me this whole time?

jp: いつか言わなくてはならないと
en: I knew I would have to tell you someday.
But I could not.

jp: 間もなく応援部隊が到着する
en: ...Go. Reinforcements will be here any moment.
...Kreis-sama.
Don't just stand there! Let's move!!

jp: ステイエンには、この醜い汚泥を
はらんだ教団の中で、心を殺し、
突き進めるほどの信念はない
en: Stayen lacks the conviction to kill her heart and push on inside this foul Church.

jp: お前の進む道を切り開く助けに
なることを祈ろう・・・
en: At the least, I pray that what I taught her helps clear the path she walks...
Kreis-sama!? Wh-what happened here!?

jp: インセストを連れて逃げ去った
en: The heretics fled with the Incest.
Kreis-sama, that wound?!
It is nothing. A mere scratch.

jp: クレイス様は早く傷の手当てを
en: Leave this to us! Kreis-sama, please see to that wound at once!
Forgive me. I leave it to you.
Sir!
...Heh heh heh.

jp: 僕の盾になると誓ったはずの男が
en: A sorry sight, for a man who swore to be my shield.
Terios-sama... My apologies.

jp: まぁ、廃棄が決まったインセスト
なんて早かれ遅かれ死ぬんだから
彼らにあげても問題ないよ
en: Well, an Incest marked for disposal dies sooner or later anyway. Let them have her.

jp: 問題なのはキミの傷の方だ
その傷じゃアラギ討伐の任務も
キミに任せられないじゃないか
en: The problem is your wound. With that, I can't entrust the Aragi hunt to you either.
I'm sorry.

jp: 真っ先にキミを叱りつけるのは
彼女の役目だったんだけどね
en: Heh heh heh. At times like this, scolding you first was always her job, wasn't it.

jp: 確か彼女は、キミが久々に本気で
鍛え上げた部下だったんだよね？
en: It'll be lonely... She was the first pupil you'd truly trained in a long while, no?

jp: ええ、ですが問題ありません
en: Yes. But it is no problem.

jp: なんだか、嬉しそうだね
何かいいことでもあったの？
en: You seem rather pleased, somehow. Did something good happen?

jp: 久々に私の血を騒がせるような
まっすぐな目を持つ者達に
en: For the first time in ages, I met people with eyes straight enough to stir my blood.

jp: それは手強い敵になりそうだね
en: ...I see. They sound like they'll be formidable enemies.
Yes.

jp: 邪魔な芽は早めに摘むべきだけど
キミを放っておくわけにも
en: Troublesome weeds should be pulled early, but I can't very well leave you like this.
Come. Let me tend to that.
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
